mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in demand, triggering short-term equity sell-offs as investors anticipate reduced corporate revenue growth over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock regime (defined by a 5% decline in industrial production over 3 months) reduces output capacity, increases inflation, and triggers tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 5% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 0.5 percentage points over 3 months) signals the Federal Reserve will tighten policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases over 6 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market downturn regime (defined by a 10% decline in housing starts over 3 months) reduces residential investment and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls > 10% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary policy response to supply constraints, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
